text:
samir: Quick async follow-up from the postmortem — short remediation tracker for credential rotation flakes. Please ack and confirm ETAs.

eva: ack. I'll own rotation-verification and the CI gate.

tony: ack. I'll handle token validation hardening and canary policy.

samir: Items:
- C1: CI preflight to verify secret presence across envs (owner: eva, ETA: 7d)
- C2: post-rotate smoke + canary watch (owner: eva, ETA: 10d)
- C3: strict token validation (sig+kid+exp) + integration tests (owner: tony, ETA: 9d)
- C4: increase auth audit sampling + add token_kid field (owner: tony, ETA: 4d)
- C5: alerts + runbook link for validation spikes (>0.4% / 15m) (owner: samir, ETA: 5d)

eva: CI preflight will run ops-cli secrets verify --name=auth_pub --env=prod,staging,canary and fail if any missing. Gate posts status to PR. Target PR: 2024-08-01.

tony: validation tests will include bad-kid, expired token, and clock-drift cases. Example: POST /auth/validate body: {"token":"bad-kid"} -> expect 401 + metric: validation.kid_mismatch. PR target: 2024-08-02.

samir: ops ran a quick scan of last 8 months — 3 clusters around vendor rotations. Primary fixes: preflight, canary watch, and better alerts.

eva: will implement canary watch: block full rollout if canary validation.failure_rate > 0.25% over 1h. Also add auto-rollback hook.

tony: I'll bump audit sampling to 35% for 30d and add saved queries for recent failures. PR for logging: 2024-07-29.

ops-bot: Created calendar rotation-checks weekly Weds 09:30 PT for 8 weeks. Created ticket SEC-7991: rotation-verification assigned to eva.

samir: decision: implement C1..C5, run weekly rotation checks for 8 weeks, owners add label "incident-2901234567-remediate" to PRs and paste links here. I'll close this thread after PR links and tracker updated.

eva: PR draft for CI job: https://redwood.internal/pull/5302 (WIP).

tony: PR for validation + tests: https://redwood.internal/pull/5306 (draft).

samir: timeline recap: C4 -> 4d, C5 -> 5d, C1 -> 7d, C3 -> 9d, C2 -> 10d. Escalate if >1 production token incident during the 8-week window. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
